dedupe_keys.name: netztransparenz de joint information platform of the german transmission system operators balancing renewable levies system services

description: Netztransparenz.de is the joint information platform of the four German transmission system operators, 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT and TransnetBW. The German-language site read on 2026-09-26 organises publications under several menus: obligations under the EU transparency regulation; the renewable energy and CHP levies (EEG and KWKG accounts, offshore grid levy and other surcharges); voluntary publications including extrapolated wind and solar generation; balancing energy, with the reBAP imbalance price, the grid control cooperation balance (NRV-Saldo) per minute and quarter hour, activated and optimised control reserve, unintended exchange, second-by-second data and an archive of older data; system services such as frequency control, market-based procurement of inertia and reactive power, redispatch and the capacity reserve; and grid charges and studies. Access is free on the web; the licence and download formats of each series were not read on the page. Coverage is the German control areas. Caveats: series are spread over many sub-pages in German, and some items are reports, not tables. Simulation uses are balancing and reserve studies, redispatch analysis and inputs for German market and grid models. Related records: data-energy-charts-api-fraunhofer-ise compiles German generation and price series.
